# Go packages NOT tested by the CI on Windows, each with its cause. See the
# header of windows-test-packages.txt: making a package green means moving it
# from this file to that one.
#
# Every package of `go list ./...` is in exactly one of the two files:
# `.github/scripts/windows-packages.sh check` fails otherwise (a new package
# must be classified in the commit that creates it).
#
# Causes come from the first full run on Windows (run 39478681062, 21/10),
# checked against the code of the tests at the release v5.1. Entries marked
# "to retry" have a cause that was never analysed, or that may have come from
# HOME not being isolated (fixed on 22/10: USERPROFILE in configtest and
# testenv): move them to the tested list as soon as a run shows they pass.
#
# Format: package, then " # cause" (one line). Same package names as
# `go list ./...`, relative to the module (cli/).
./cmd                           # fake editors and binaries written as shell scripts ("not a valid Win32 application"), team id built from a temporary path that is not a slug
./internal/adapters/opencodev2  # fake servers written as shell scripts, Unix file modes (0755/0600), "/opt/oh/..." paths turned into backslashes
./internal/beads                # runs the real bd (not installed on the Windows runner) and fake bd written as shell scripts
./internal/beads/bdtest         # TestCopyTree expects the Unix file mode (0640) and the "b/f" symbolic link target; the real bd tests need the bd binary
./internal/bricks               # stack detection of an android project (TestResolveStackSkills_Projects/android) differs: file path handling
./internal/bundle               # backslash paths in the rendered annexes, shell guard tests that expect a Unix shell
./internal/daemon               # shortPaths creates its folders in /tmp (daemon_test.go), Unix sockets, Unix file modes
./internal/gateway              # Beads workspace paths with backslashes, fake bd written as a shell script
./internal/gitutil              # TestSafeGitIgnoresRepoConfig: the repo config runs a shell script as fsmonitor hook
./internal/runsvc               # "/work/proj" paths turned into backslashes, Unix file modes, shell script fakes
./internal/runtime              # TestPathMap: inner Unix paths rewritten with backslashes (filepath)
./internal/runtime/container    # the container runtime is not supported on Windows (engine.go), the fake engine (oh-fake-engine) is a shell script
./internal/selfupdate           # self-update is unsupported on Windows (AssetName returns "unsupported OS"), TestAssetName_CurrentPlatform expects a name
./internal/services/checkpoint  # runtime env tests expect Unix paths (HOME=/home/oh), go build run without GOCACHE/LocalAppData
./internal/services/session     # to retry: TestSubscribePollsWithoutDaemon (live_test.go) failed, cause never analysed (daemon discovery written for Unix?)
./internal/services/workflow    # to retry: publication to a team-state git remote (publish_test.go) failed, Windows paths, never analysed
./internal/storage/sqlite       # Unix file modes (0600/0700 expected in migrate_test.go and server_password_test.go), TestMultiProcessOpen starts helper processes on one database
./internal/teamstate            # "/" separators expected in brick and claim paths
./internal/termlaunch           # tmux and terminal fakes written as shell scripts
./internal/worktree             # "/" separators expected in sibling paths, line endings in TestStash
